svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SPI bus timing
svg.desc: SPI timing of the TMC5160 in mode 3: CSN low frames a 40-bit datagram, SDI is read on each rising SCK edge and SDO changes after each falling edge, with the setup, hold and select times the datasheet gives.
svg.text: SPI mode 3 (CPOL 1, CPHA 1). Datasheet: 4.3 Timing, p. 25; 4.2 SPI Signals,
SCK valid before or after a change of CSN
CSN high time (min tCLK with a synchronous clock only)
SCK low time (min tCLK with a synchronous clock only)
SCK high time (min tCLK with a synchronous clock only)
SDI setup time before the rising edge of SCK
SDI hold time after the rising edge of SCK
SDO valid after the falling edge of SCK (no load on SDO)
SDI, SCK and CSN filter delay
SCK frequency with an external 16 MHz clock
SCK frequency with the internal clock
Inputs are filtered: pulses shorter than 20 ns are ignored.
